ComponentRef.description: Where a garment of the project is stored.

casing_edge_id.description: Edge along which the drawstring casing runs (e.g. Waistband Top or Hood Front).

cord_radius_mm.description: Cord cross-section radius in mm (e.g. 2.5–4.0 mm).

eyelet_offset_mm.description: Eyelet offset from Center Front along the casing, in mm (e.g. 18–25 mm).

opposite_edge_id.description:
Optional opposite edge of the casing strip (e.g. Waistband Seam) so eyelets sit
centered in the band height.

tail_length_mm.description: Hanging cord tail length emerging from each eyelet, in mm (e.g. 160–240 mm).

EdgeRef.description: Deterministic UUID-based edge reference inside a SeamInterface.

stiffness_n_m.description: Elastic tensile stiffness in N/m (120–350 N/m typical).

target_ratio.description: Ratio of finished relaxed elastic length to drafted pattern edge length (0.45..1.0).

width_mm.description: Elastic width in mm (used for homogenized casing mass/bend band).

FabricConstruction.description: How a fabric is constructed. Drives defaults, grouping in the UI and the stretch behaviour.

FabricFinish.description: Surface finish used by the 3D renderer. It changes the look only, never the physics.

buckling_ratio.description:
Resistance to in-plane compression relative to stretching (0.02..1). Lower values let the
fabric gather into soft wrinkles instead of buckling into sharp creases.

GarmentComponent.description:
One garment of a project (a tee, a vest, trousers): its template, ease, formulas, fabrics,
construction history and pieces. Every component of a file is drafted on the same body.

id.description: Written once when the component is created and saved with it.

id_ns.description:
Namespace for the IDs its template drafts (empty for the first component of a file and
for migrated files, so their IDs stay as they were). See [`remap_entity_ids`].

layer.description:
Garment layer in the 3D fit (0 = next to the body). Tucking a tee into trousers is
giving the tee the lower layer.

offset_2d.description: Where its drafted pieces sit on the 2D canvas, mm.

role_fabrics.description: Fabrics for piece roles other than the shell (rib, lining, contrast...).

visible.description: Shown on the 2D canvas and in exports.

visible_3d.description:
Shown in the 3D fit. A hidden garment is still worn (the others drape over it), it is
only not drawn, so hiding an outer layer reveals what is under it.

depth_mm.description: Finished hem depth in mm (e.g. 15–40 mm).

turn_out.description: True for an exterior turn-up cuff (*revers*), false for inward ourlet.

modified.description: When the file was written (ISO 8601), as given by the writing app.

parts.description: Every part except `mimetype` and the manifest itself.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the part's bytes.

PatternProject.description: A `.modelist` project: one body, one size run, and the garments (components) worn on it.

active_component.description: The component edits, the parameters page and the timeline apply to.

PatternProject.title: PatternProject

ProjectDoc.description: `project.json`: the project without its garments, which have one part each.
ProjectDoc.title: ProjectDoc

RoleFabric.description: Fabric assigned to a piece role other than the shell (e.g. "rib", "lining", "contrast").

SeamInterface.description: Ordered sequence of edges forming a logical connection boundary (GarmentCode-inspired).

description: Parts of a .modelist ZIP container. The first ZIP entry is `mimetype` (stored, content application/vnd.modelist+zip). `manifest.json` follows `Manifest`, `project.json` follows `ProjectDoc`, each `components/<id>/component.json` follows `GarmentComponent`. `PatternProject` is the same project assembled into one JSON document (the debug export and the version-0 .modelist.json files).
